passages.text:
Re: heads up: a few partnership possibilities
[contact omitted] Vera Zakem Tuesday, August 9, 2022 at 1:37:33 PM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [opaque block] [contact omitted] Josh Blumenfeld
Cc: [contact omitted] Johnny Walsh, [contact omitted] Joshua Machleder
Hi Josh,
Great to see we are moving forward on a bunch of these initiatives!
As promised, I wanted to share a detailed proposal from one of our key implementing partners, Internews and our
regional mission in Thailand to support independent media. This one I believe is very exciting, and one that could be quite
innovative!
Happy to schedule a chat with myself and Josh, as well as put you in touch with our mission as well.
Cheers, Vera
On Tue, Aug 9, 2022 at 1:27 PM Josh Blumenfeld < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Vera and Johnny,
Apologies for the delay in my response. Details below in red.
Many thanks,
Josh
On Sun, Aug 7, 2022 at 3:55 PM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
HeyJosh,
How are you doing?
I hope your folks were able to get connected with our LAC folks on communications training with You Tube. Please let
me know how it goes! Yes, meeting with LAC later this week to disucss the How YouTube Works training.
Separately, I wanted to give you a heads up of a few potential collaboration possibilities:
• We'll speak with our local team in Moldova tomorrow - there is an interest there for sure, but 1 know they have
a bunch of Qs. I'll join the convo for the first 15 min. We had a great conversation with the Molodova and
Ukraine team about Russian language independent media. Lots of Als and follow ups.
• Thailand- our implementing partner internews and our regional mission there are really interested in
collaborating and partnering with you guys! The put together a full proposal. I'm waiting to get the right POC
for internews, but this will come to you in the next couple of days and represents an incredible opportunity.
Thrilled to hear it and very much looking forward to it. This model for a PPP on indepenent media could work
extremely well in SE Asia. As an aside, some of my team and I will be in Bangkok in November for APEO
where we will have a YouTube Creators studio of journalists from the US, Korea, Japan, and Indonesia
interviewing key government officials.
Cheers and more to follow,
Vera
Attachments:
IN_YouTube_ConceptNote_MediaHumanRights_SEA.docx 44k
IN_YouTube_Budget_MediaHumanRights_SEA.xlsx 37k
